name: network
title: Network
description: A circular diagram of two dashed rings packed with small portrait avatars around a larger central one. Every few seconds a glowing coloured line draws between two random people and their names appear as little labels.
use: A section should convey many people connected around one hub, such as a community or team map.
avoid: Names and portraits are hardcoded inside the file, so adapting it to real people means editing the source.
a11y: Names only appear on hover or while linked, and nothing is focusable, so keyboard users never see them. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark field with two faint dashed circles, the outer ring crowded with small round portraits and the inner ring a little smaller, all around one large central face. Small white name pills float above a few avatars.
behaves: Every four seconds the previous link vanishes and a new coloured line draws itself between two random portraits while their name pills fade in; hovering any avatar also reveals its name. The whole layout rescales with the window.
customise: It takes no props: the portrait URLs, names, ring counts and timing are fixed in the file, so adapting it means editing the arrays and the four-second interval.
weight: moderate: Two dozen avatar images plus one SVG line that redraws every four seconds.
